optimizedDescription.value: Backend-neutral `GraphStore` contract for atomic persistence, indexed search, freshness, recovery, and deterministic bulk access.

optimizedContext.value:
# Graph Store

## Rules

- `GraphStore`: abstract class in `domain/ports/`; constructor `storagePath`. Concrete `infrastructure/` adapters own schema/layout/backend details; consumers rely only on abstract semantics.
- Persist `FileNode` with canonical workspace-prefixed path, config-relative path, full content, `contentHash`; `SymbolNode`, `SpecNode`, `DocumentNode`; metadata `lastIndexedAt`, `lastIndexedRef`, graph fingerprint; relations `IMPORTS`, `DEFINES`, `CALLS`, `CONSTRUCTS`, `USES_TYPE`, `EXPORTS`, `DEPENDS_ON`, `COVERS_FILE`, `COVERS_SYMBOL`, `EXTENDS`, `IMPLEMENTS`, `OVERRIDES`. `COVERS_SYMBOL` may carry `metadata.stale`. Full file content enables snippets without live disk reads. Support document upsert/remove/search and incremental `contentHash` comparison.
- `open()`: explicit, parameterless, never clear/recreate; prepares backend/bindings/schema/generation; corruption or unsafe incompatibility throws typed recoverable storage-open error. `close()`: idempotent, observably closed after partial open failure. Any operation while closed throws `StoreNotOpenError`.
- `recreate()`: physical recovery for unusable storage; requires closed store, otherwise typed precondition error; replaces persistence, rotates storage generation, leaves closed. `clear()`: opened healthy store only; removes logical contents, preserves physical database/generation; forced full reindex uses `clear()`. Hosts never manipulate backend/WAL files.
- Persist generation marker under storage root; destructive recreation rotates it; provider caches at `open()` and detects cross-process replacement before reads.
- Atomic mutations: `upsertFile(file, symbols, relations)` replaces file/symbols/relations or preserves prior state on failure; `removeFile(filePath)` removes file, its symbols, incident relations. `addRelations(relations)` additive only. `upsertSpec(spec, relations)` atomically replaces spec and outgoing `DEPENDS_ON`; `removeSpec(specId)` removes spec and incident `DEPENDS_ON`.
- Single queries: `getFile`, `findFilesByConfigRelativePath`, `getSymbol`, callers/callees, importers/importees, extenders/extended targets, implementors/implemented targets, overriders/overridden targets, `getSpec`, spec dependencies/dependents, direct/inverse file/symbol coverage, `findSymbols(SymbolQuery)`. `SymbolQuery`: optional glob/regex `name`, `kinds`, exact/glob `filePath`, comment substring, `caseSensitive=false`.
- Traversal batches: `getSymbolsByIds`, `getIncomingSymbolRelations`, `getOutgoingSymbolRelations`; support `CALLS`, `CONSTRUCTS`, `USES_TYPE`, `EXTENDS`, `IMPLEMENTS`, `OVERRIDES`. Deduplicate input; omit unknown ids; empty ids/types returns empty without backend work; symbols follow requested-id order; relations sort source/type/target. No storage call per symbol/type; transparent physical chunking allowed.
- Exact batches: `getFilesByPaths`, `getDocumentsByPaths`, `getSpecsByIds`; arbitrary order accepted, duplicates collapsed by first request, absent omitted, empty no-work, results first-request order, no call per identity. Single and complete-collection APIs remain. Never derive display paths through store.
- `getStatistics()`: `fileCount`, `symbolCount`, `specCount`, `relationCounts`, `languages`, `lastIndexedAt`, `lastIndexedRef`, `graphFingerprint`.
- Search: `searchSymbols`, `searchSpecs`, `searchDocuments`, `rebuildFtsIndexes`; match-aware snippets plus 1-based `startLine`/`endLine`. Primary identities: spec `specId`; symbol `name`/`id`; document `path`/persisted alternate path. Generic text retrieval remains.
- Shared lexical expansion preserves normalized originals; splits whitespace, `:`, `/`, `_`, `.`, `-`, CamelCase/PascalCase; never classifies intent. Ranking: exact canonical identity > exact primary/alternate identity > identity prefix/suffix/substring > generic BM25/content; structured component > arbitrary substring; more token coverage wins. Token strength: exact > prefix > suffix > substring. Identity-derived candidates may supplement backend FTS. Filters apply before `limit`.
- `SearchOptions`: required `query`; `limit=20`; `kind`, `filePattern`, `workspace`, `excludePaths`, `excludeWorkspaces`. `clear()`, `getAllFiles()`, `getAllSpecs()` support full/incremental indexing.
- Atomically persist logical-symbol identity, declarations, symbol spaces, member forms, public/local bindings, provenance, file/package coverage. Preserve distinct bindings/routes sharing endpoints. Indexed lookup by workspace, surface, simple name, symbol space, owner, member form, declaration, exported name, local scope, coverage. Canonical ids remain unique external identities but never parsed, case-folded, or substring-searched for selector resolution/semantic ranking.
- Provide deterministic complete reference-fact snapshot and batched directly affected-file query over import/call/construct/type-use/extend/implement/override. Search indexes structured reference fields, groups bindings with logical target, returns each binding plus matching provenance. Reverse coverage batches accept paths/ids, deterministic source/type/target; empty no-work; full blast-radius coverage without per-resource calls.
- Persist full symbol construct/selection ranges. Backend-neutral source-content candidate query receives normalized complete query, raw/expanded terms, category limit, path/workspace filters, exclusions, snippet preference; returns file, backend relevance, content/precise evidence without live filesystem. Substring-capable index for queries >=3 chars; bounded short-query fallback; never scan/return all files for ordinary search. Store returns candidates only; application owns cross-category merge, provenance, suppression, ranking, grouping, final limits.
- Incompatible schema rejects reads, never silently recreates. Indexing repair performs destructive rebuild, rotates generation, rebuilds search indexes. Derived cache requires no incremental migration.
- Persist `IndexedInputObservation` separately: workspace, logical resource kind/id, input kind, non-absolute logical locator, content hash, optional mtime/size or revision, monotonic stale. Files/documents usually one observation; aggregate specs record every producing content/metadata/persisted-state input. Batch/CAS supports stale marking, equal-content refresh, atomic workspace/global latches; assessment predating reindex cannot mutate new evidence. Persist `knownStaleSinceLastIndex` per workspace plus aggregate; only successful indexing clears stale/latches; transient unknown never persists stale.
- One bulk indexing session: begin once; bounded file/document/spec/symbol/semantic-fact/observation/relation chunks; commit once; rebuild semantic/source indexes once. Batch endpoint validation and hierarchy/method lookup; no per-relation existence/hierarchy calls; deduplicate equivalent relations across chunks; failure exposes no partial generation.

## Constraints

- Backend-neutral abstract class, never interface; no `@specd/core`; errors extend `CodeGraphError`.
- File-level mutations atomic; no partial updates.
- Batch results deterministic; transparent physical chunking allowed.
- Backend, physical schema, filesystem layout unspecified.
- Destructive reset via provider/indexing-owned `recreate()`, never caller file deletion.
- Persisted storage-generation marker required for cross-process stale detection.
